title: 第820章 应有尽有绝对被人骗了第819章 星空炸弹双人紧急拆弹
content_zh:
接下来的几天，船上恢复了平静。
走廊里巡逻的护卫队人数没有减少，但步伐比之前松弛了一些。
乘客也基本上知道护卫队前几天晚上干掉了俩个杀手，但没人知道其实是令狐黎干的。
令狐黎偶尔在餐厅遇到船长，船长会朝他点点头，他也会回一个点头，双方都没有停下来交谈。
炎君和女帝大多数时间待在隔间里修炼，偶尔出来透透气，但在走廊里停留的时间不长。
“这个空间戒指里面怎么应有尽有啊？就连斗士丹都有，这薛听雨也用不上啊。”女帝将三枚灰白色的斗士丹取出，放在手心。
“还正好三枚，而且这种类型的丹药一枚一个境界。”炎君说着，神识探入他那枚戒指深处，沿着丹药堆码的排列方式扫了一遍，从外围到中心，从表面到底层，耐心地顺着分层的结构逐一确认了一遍它的大致范围和不同品阶的分布位置。
过了一会儿，只见炎君嘴角微抽。
“我这里面一百多枚斗士丹。”他收回神识，抹了一把脸，语气带着一种被投喂过量的无奈，“哥哥把薛听雨当垃圾桶了。这玩意儿只能拿去卖了。”
女帝嘴角微微一抽，“还得是邪帝大哥。”
她把三枚斗士丹收进戒指内，又从中取出几枚更高修为的丹药逐一查看过表面的成色，“这里面的修为丹药一路到超神丹，还有半个月的路程，我感觉我们可以一路磕到超神境。”
“这么吃不会拉肚子么？”炎君嘴上是这么说，但已经塞了两颗武士丹进嘴里。
煌曜九眛吞天焰在他体内随即亮起，将那两枚丹药同时包裹，火焰覆盖丹药表面的瞬间就将其完全吞噬，药效被剥离出来，沿着经脉快速扩散。
他的身体在药效流过时微微绷紧了一下，随即又松开。
“来感觉了。”炎君盘膝坐下，吐出一口带着余热的气息，修为径直晋升到了战士境初期，过程平稳，没有出现明显的瓶颈或阻滞。
就是这么的平平无奇。
“不愧是八品上等武士丹，这突破完全像水到渠成一样，也不损伤根基。”女帝虽然吃过很多邪帝的丹药，但还是忍不住感慨道。
“我去给两颗超神丹给令狐黎吧。”炎君站起身，摸出一个小瓶子，抖了两颗浅灰色的超神丹进去，又掂了掂，确认数量没有出错，“够他迈入超神境巅峰了吧，说不定还能冲击破天境。”
“绰绰有余好吧。”女帝点点头，“我也回去准备修炼了。”她站起身，推门朝自己的隔间走去。
炎君一同出去敲响了隔壁的门。

令狐黎正坐在窗边，看着外面的星域。他听见敲门声，头也没回说了一声“进”。
炎君推门走进来，站在门口，把那只小瓷瓶递了过去：“送你点东西。”
“这是什么？”令狐黎凑近看了看，闻到了一股香味，“好香啊。”
“超神丹。两颗。一颗够你到超神境后期，两颗吃完直接冲进巅峰。运气好还能摸到破天境的门槛。”炎君眉头一挑笑着说道。
令狐黎看了他一眼，接过瓷瓶拔开塞子看了一眼，又合上递回去：“我不要。”
“为什么？”炎君微微一愣，没想到令狐黎是这般反应。
“丹药吃多了，体内会积攒杂质。而且容易上瘾，用完灵力后习惯了那种快速提升，就很难静下心来慢慢修炼了。”令狐黎把瓷瓶塞回炎君手里，“我要靠自己练。”
content_en:
Over the next few days, calm returned to the ship.
The number of escorts patrolling the corridors has not decreased, but the pace is a little more relaxed than before.
The passengers basically knew that the escort killed two killers a few nights ago, but no one knew that it was Linghu Li who did it.
Linghu Li occasionally met the captain in the restaurant. The captain would nod to him and he would nod back. Neither party stopped to talk.
Yanjun and the Empress spent most of their time practicing in the cubicle. They occasionally came out to get some air, but they didn't stay in the corridor for long.
"How come this space ring has everything in it? It even has Fighter Pills, but Xue Tingyu doesn't need them." The empress took out three gray-white Fighter Pills and placed them in the palm of her hand.
"There are exactly three of them, and each elixir of this type has a different level." Yan Jun said, his spiritual consciousness penetrated into the depths of his ring, and scanned along the arrangement of the elixir stacks, from the periphery to the center, from the surface to the bottom, and patiently followed the layered structure to confirm its approximate range and distribution position of different grades one by one.
After a while, Yan Jun’s mouth twitched slightly.
"I have more than a hundred Fighting Pills in here." He withdrew his consciousness and wiped his face, his tone was helpless as if he had been overfed, "Brother treats Xue Tingyu as a trash can. This thing can only be sold."
The corners of the empress' lips twitched slightly, "It has to be Brother Evil Emperor."
She put the three fighter pills into the ring, and took out several higher cultivation pills to check the surface quality one by one. "The cultivation pills here all the way to the super god pill are still half a month away. I feel that we can reach the super god realm all the way."
"Won't you get diarrhea if you eat like this?" Yan Jun said, but he had already stuffed two Samurai Pills into his mouth.
The Nine-Glow Sky Swallowing Flame immediately lit up in his body, wrapping the two elixirs at the same time. The moment the flames covered the surface of the elixirs, they were completely devoured. The effects of the medicines were stripped out and spread rapidly along the meridians.
His body tensed slightly as the effects of the medicine flowed through, then relaxed again.
"Come and feel it." Yan Jun sat down cross-legged and exhaled a breath of residual heat. His cultivation level was directly promoted to the early stage of warrior realm. The process was smooth and there were no obvious bottlenecks or obstacles.
It's just so ordinary.
"As expected of an eighth-grade superior warrior elixir, this breakthrough comes naturally and does not damage the foundation." Although the empress had taken many elixirs from the Evil Emperor, she still couldn't help but sigh.
"I'm going to give two Super God Pills to Linghu Li." Yan Jun stood up, took out a small bottle, shook two light gray Super God Pills into it, weighed them again, and confirmed that the quantity was correct, "It's enough for him to reach the peak of the Super God Realm, and maybe he can also break into the Sky Breaking Realm."
"It's more than enough." The empress nodded, "I'm going back to prepare for practice." She stood up, opened the door and walked towards her cubicle.
Yan Jun went out together and knocked on the door next door.
Linghu Li was sitting by the window, looking at the star field outside. He heard a knock on the door and said "come in" without turning around.
Yan Jun pushed the door open and walked in. He stood at the door and handed the small porcelain bottle over: "I'll give you something."
"What is this?" Linghu Li looked closer and smelled a scent, "It smells so good."
"Super Divine Pill. Two pills. One pill is enough for you to reach the late stage of Super Divine Realm. Take two pills and rush straight to the peak. If you are lucky, you can even touch the threshold of Breaking Heaven Realm." Yan Jun said with a raised eyebrow and a smile.
Linghu Li glanced at him, took the porcelain bottle, uncorked it, took a look, closed it and handed it back: "I don't want it."
"Why?" Yan Jun was slightly stunned, but he didn't expect Linghu Li to react like this.
"If you take too many elixirs, impurities will accumulate in your body. It is also easy to become addicted. Once you are used to the rapid improvement after using up your spiritual power, it will be difficult to calm down and practice slowly." Linghu Li put the porcelain bottle back into Yan Jun's hand, "I have to practice on my own.。”
